_comment: Keyword pipeline for Howard Wedding Rentals. Sorted by priority_score DESC. Status lifecycle: queued -> in_progress -> published (or skipped). A 'skipped' entry MUST carry skip_reason and skipped_date so triage does not resurface it; skipped entries are permanent rulings, not deferrals.

queue.search_intent: informational — searcher wants to understand what church pews are; top-of-funnel opportunity to introduce church pew rental services for weddings
queue.suggested_angle: Definitive guide to church pews — what they are, their history, and how couples can rent authentic solid hardwood pews for their ceremony instead of standard folding chairs

queue.search_intent: commercial — bride shopping for name tags or place cards to help guests identify themselves at the reception
queue.suggested_angle: Clarify the difference between wedding name tags and place cards — when each makes sense, what guests actually prefer, and how to order printed place cards that double as keepsakes

queue.keyword: wedding place cards with meal choice
queue.parent_topic: wedding place cards with meal choice
queue.search_intent: transactional — bride planning a plated dinner needs place cards that clearly indicate each guest's meal selection to the caterer
queue.suggested_angle: How to create wedding place cards that show each guest's meal selection — design tips, what to print, how caterers use them, and ordering options including custom printed cards

queue.search_intent: navigational/transactional — bride wants a free online tool to build her wedding seating chart without paying for software
queue.suggested_angle: Roundup of the best free seating chart maker tools — compare Canva, SeatPlan, and other options, then explain why Howard's drag-and-drop tool is purpose-built for weddings (not classrooms)

queue.search_intent: commercial — shopper (likely a bride or event planner) looking to buy place cards for a seated dinner table setting
queue.suggested_angle: What to know before buying place cards for wedding tables — sizes, fold styles, printing options, and why custom printed cards are worth the upgrade over blank card stock
queue.skip_reason: cannibalization — the suggested angle (sizes, fold styles, printing options, what to order) is already the substance of the published article wedding-place-cards-guide. Publishing it would split intent signals between two of our own pages. Better folded into that article as a new section.

queue.search_intent: informational — bride planning her ceremony seating arrangement and looking for a visual template to share with her venue coordinator
queue.suggested_angle: Free wedding ceremony chair layout guide — standard row configurations, how many chairs per row, pew vs. chair comparisons, and a printable template to review with your venue
queue.skip_reason: traffic floor — volume 100 and traffic_potential 100 are both at the phase-1 minimum, so ranking it would not measurably move traffic. Still worth writing later as a conversion asset for the pew rental service (KD 3, highest-margin pillar), but not as a traffic play.
